verdict.rationale: Stable explicitly offers a real virtual business address (not a PO Box) that can be used with the IRS, state, vendors, and requires USPS Form 1583 onboarding — the standard process for legal mail-receiving addresses used in LLC registration and KYC. Docs also mention registered agent locations tied to a company for state/legal correspondence, and change-of-address guidance for switching an LLC's registered address. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of bank KYC acceptance and independent/hands-on verification that vendors/banks accept the address.
